summary: A lace-up safety boot: a tall padded ankle shaft, a steel toe cap and a deep lugged sole. options channel0, channel1; sockets grip_r, grip_l, holster_r, sling_back.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.garment_feet_boots_work or place "prefab": "garment_feet_boots_work" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
